column1: # pr-create-guard — blocks PR creation when a prerequisite is missing, and emits a
# checklist when none is. Every case runs against a repo built by fixture_env.pr_create,
# because this guard decides from git state rather than from the command string: point
# it at whatever happens to be checked out and the verdicts flap with the day.
# `cd {token} && ...` is how each case selects its repo. The guard runs bare git, so
# the leading cd is what puts it in the right tree.
#!setup pr-create
# --- must block: the four states where the PR would be wrong or empty ---
hard
column2: cd {zero} && gh pr create --title x --body y

column1: hard
column2: cd {unpushed} && gh pr create --title x --body y

column1: hard
column2: cd {dirty} && gh pr create --title x --body y

column1: # --- must emit the checklist: everything is in order ---
ctx
column2: cd {ready} && gh pr create --title x --body y

column1: # --- unmeasurable is not empty. With no origin/main the zero-diff check could not
# run, and blocking there would assert a measurement nobody took. The guard allows,
# and this case pins that as a decision rather than an accident.
allow
column2: cd {noorigin} && gh pr create --title x --body y

column1: # --- the stack form. `gh stack submit` creates or updates EVERY pull request in the
# stack, so a dirty tree costs N pull requests missing the work, not one. The guard
# matched only the single-PR spelling until this fixture was written, exiting 0 here
# while hard-blocking the create form in the same tree.
hard
ctx
# --- must not fire: neither spelling present ---
allow
allow
allow
# --- must not fire on the words appearing as message text rather than as an
# invocation. A guard that matches its own trigger inside a commit subject blocks
# the commit that documents it.
allow
column2: cd {ready} && git commit -m "docs: explain when to run gh pr create vs gh stack submit"

column1: # --- input unavailable: the extraction returns nothing, which is indistinguishable
# from "no command to guard". Pinned so a later edit cannot flip it silently.
allow
